purpose: Teach: 発泡/源流/ソプラノ/ジェンダーフリー/右腕/語尾/踏切/出走

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、発泡スチロール詰めの遺体事案を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police are handling this foam-packed body case, then.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft interrogative lilt on the final particle. Building a checklist in real time—careful, slightly formal. Not quite asking permission, more inviting confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪の源流を遡る捜査もされますね
lines.en: Yes, and the police are also tracing the crime back to its origin.
lines.style: Calm, professional assurance. Even weight on each phrase. A light nod in the voice—collaborative, not defensive. The tone of someone who's explained this before and doesn't mind explaining it again.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、ソプラノの声紋分析を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: And the police are pursuing voice analysis of the soprano range as well.
lines.style: Same measured tempo as before. Slight curiosity underneath—testing the waters. Not doubting, just confirming that this particular angle matters. Soft emphasis on the technical detail.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ジェンダーフリー化された制服も導入されますね
lines.en: That's right. We're also implementing gender-neutral uniforms across the department.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. No apologizing for policy. Light affirmative emphasis. The voice of institutional decision-making done with quiet conviction, not performance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯人の右腕の刺青鑑定を、警察、おこなわれますね
lines.en: So the police are also conducting a forensic assessment of the suspect's right arm tattoo.
lines.style: Picking up pace slightly—more engaged now. Still formal, but a thread of genuine interest beneath. Light stress on the specificity of 'right arm.' The rhythm of someone building toward a larger question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の語尾の特徴も声紋分析されますね
lines.en: We're also analyzing the suspect's distinctive speech patterns in the voice sample.
lines.style: Professional continuity. Matching Ren's pace now—collaborative energy building. Slight emphasis on 'distinctive,' showing the forensic weight of what sounds minor. Clear-eyed, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、踏切事故の捜査を、警察、担当されますね
lines.en: And the police are handling the level crossing accident investigation as well.
lines.style: Pause deepens slightly—this one carries different weight. Still formal, but a thread of concern showing through. The voice of someone naming something darker. Quiet intensity on 'accident.' No trailing off—just landing it clearly.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、競馬の出走前不正もご捜査ですね
lines.en: Yes, and we're investigating the pre-race irregularities in the horse racing as well.
lines.style: Slight shift—warmer now, almost conversational while staying professional. A touch of wry acknowledgment in the delivery, like this particular case detail is unusual even for them. Still grounded. Light breath-ease at the end.
